# Copilot Instructions

# Project: T-Rex Runner

## Goal
Create a browser-based clone of the Chrome T-Rex Runner game using JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas.

## Core Gameplay
* The dinosaur runs automatically.
* The player can jump over obstacles.
* The game speed gradually increases.
* Collision with an obstacle ends the game.
* The score increases over time.

## Technical Requirements
* JavaScript
* HTML5 Canvas
* No game engine
* No external dependencies unless justified

## Features

### MVP

* T-Rex character
* Jump mechanic
* Cactus obstacles
* Collision detection
* Score counter
* Game Over screen
* Restart game

### Future Features
* Flying enemies
* Day/Night cycle
* Sound effects
* Mobile controls
* Leaderboard

## Code Quality Requirements
* Modular architecture
* Separate game systems
* Unit tests for core logic
* ESLint compliance
* No global mutable state unless required

## Deliverables
* Working game
* Automated tests
* Documentation
* Build instructions

## Git Rules (Agent — NORMATIVE)

* **Stage all new files**: After creating any new file, run `git add <file>` (or `git add .`) immediately.
* **No autonomous commits**: Never run `git commit` without explicit user approval. Stage changes, then stop and ask the user to review and confirm.
* **No force-push**: Never run `git push --force`.
* **No branch deletion**: Never delete a branch without user confirmation.

See [`.github/skills/git/SKILL.md`](.github/skills/git/SKILL.md) for the full Git usage guide.
